art_note: The imagery features generic supplier style with flat digital prints and repetitive size charts, falling short of luxury e-commerce standards.
desc_en: A refined silhouette defines this sleeveless mini dress, designed for effortless elegance. Crafted from a lightweight fabric with a round neckline and straight cut, it presents a sleek and minimalist look. The design features a hidden zipper at the back and falls gracefully to the mid-upper thigh. A versatile piece for any sophisticated occasion. Made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta depurada define este minivestido sin mangas, concebido para una elegancia sin esfuerzo. Confeccionado en un tejido ligero con cuello redondo y corte recto, ofrece un aspecto minimalista y limpio. El diseño incluye una cremallera oculta en la espalda y cae con gracia hasta la altura del muslo. Una prenda versátil para cualquier ocasión sofisticada. Disponible bajo pedido con envío a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Composition: 100% polyester
· Straight and minimalist cut
· Round neckline and sleeveless design
· Hidden zipper at the back
· Hand or machine wash at a maximum of 45ºC
· Made-to-order piece with worldwide shipping
